address.landmark: Near India Gate and Rashtrapati Bhavan

timings.early_check_in_policy: Early check-in from 9:00 AM is complimentary subject to room availability.
timings.late_check_out_policy: Late check-out up to 3:00 PM available for INR 1,500.

rooms.name: Heritage Classic Room
rooms.description: Colonial high-ceiling room featuring hand-woven Kashmiri carpets, Burma teak writing desk, and heritage brass fittings.
amenities: Air Purifier with HEPA Filter in Room

rooms.name: Viceroy Executive Suite
rooms.description: Stately colonial suite with separate diplomatic drawing room, antique crystal chandeliers, and club lounge privileges.
amenities: Complimentary High Tea & Evening Single Malts

rooms.name: Lutyens' Imperial Suite
rooms.description: Unrivaled imperial suite hosting state guests, with banquet table for 8, bullet-resistant acoustic windows, and 24/7 personal butler.

dining.name: Haveli 1911
dining.cuisine: Royal Awadhi & Mughlai Cuisine, Dum Pukht Specialties
dining.breakfast_timings: 6:30 AM – 10:30 AM at The Palm Court
dining.breakfast_inclusion: Complimentary breakfast buffet included with Viceroy Suite and Lutyens Suite. INR 850 + taxes for Heritage Classic Room.
dining.highlights: Authentic slow-cooked Dal Bukhara, fragrant saffron biryanis, and live sitar recitals.

dining.name: The Palm Court Tea Salon
dining.cuisine: Traditional English High Tea, Scones & Artisanal Darjeeling First Flush
dining.highlights: Sunlit colonial glass atrium with live harpist and fresh clotted cream scones.

menu.name: First Flush Darjeeling Castleton Tea
menu.description: Fragrant muscatel tea steeped in a bone china teapot with fresh mint and lemon slices.

menu.name: Royal Kashmiri Kahwa
menu.description: Green tea leaves brewed with saffron strands, whole cinnamon, green cardamom, and slivered almonds.

menu.name: Murgh Yakhni Shorba / Subz Shorba
menu.description: Delicate, light clear broth slow-simmered with crushed ginger, whole peppercorns, and mint.

menu.name: Steamed Moong Sprouts & Pomegranate Chaat
menu.description: Warm organic sprouted lentils tossed with fresh pomegranate pearls, mint chutney, and roasted cumin.

menu.name: Slow-Simmered Black Dal Makhani with Naan
menu.description: Black lentils cooked overnight on slow charcoal fire with cultured butter, served with crisp butter naan.

menu.name: Stuffed Amritsari Aloo Paratha with White Butter
menu.description: Crisp flaky whole wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced potatoes, served with homemade white butter and curd.

menu.name: Royal Shahi Tukda with Pistachio Rabdi
menu.description: Ghee-fried bread soaked in aromatic saffron cardamom syrup, topped with thick condensed milk rabdi.

amenities.name: Colonial Heated Pool & Sundeck
amenities.details: Surrounded by landscaped Lutyens' gardens and Greek colonnades.

amenities.name: Mughal Garden Jogging Track
amenities.details: Private 1-km track winding through manicured roses and fountains.

amenities.name: Soma Spa & Wellness Sanctuary
amenities.details: Authentic Ayurvedic therapies, crystal steam rooms, and yoga pavilion.

services.name: Extra Towels
services.description: Fresh plush bath and face towels.

services.name: Complimentary Water Bottles
services.description: Spring water in sanitised glass bottles.

services.name: Private Airport Chauffeur (IGI T3)
services.description: Luxury Mercedes or Audi chauffeur transfer to Indira Gandhi International Airport.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 24 hours prior to check-in.
policies.pets: Pets not permitted in heritage rooms.
policies.smoking: Smoke-free hotel. Designate outdoor garden pavilion available.
policies.id_requirements: Valid government ID required at check-in.

faqs.question: What time is check-in?
faqs.answer: Check-in at Oleria Delhi Heritage is from 2:00 PM onwards, and check-out is at 12:00 PM noon.

faqs.question: Where is the hotel situated?
faqs.answer: Oleria Delhi Heritage is located at 24 Janpath, Connaught Place, right in the heart of diplomatic New Delhi near India Gate.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes, our outdoor colonnade-style heated pool is situated in the private Mughal gardens and is open from 6:30 AM to 9:30 PM.
